title: Plastic area limitations for internally illuminated signs.
officialText: Except as provided for in Sections 402.14 and 2611 of this code, approved plastic used on the display surface of internally illuminated signs shall be permitted up to 200 square feet (18.6 m2) in area on signs required to be of noncombustible construction and on signs permitted to be of combustible construction.
